_meta.description: Real-time status of all five inference layers (L1-L5) with current veto states and active signals. L1 veto states propagate directly to decision output — no higher layer can override. Updated on every agent action.
_meta.update_policy: Updated via cdi_update.py on every L1-L5 state change.

arbitration_invariant: Higher layers cannot override deterministic vetoes from lower layers. L1 vetoes propagate directly to the decision output, bypassing all higher layers. A known-bad data signature at L1 is not outvoted by the LLM's narrative assessment.

layers.name: Heuristic Layer
layers.designation: DETERMINISTIC — CAN VETO ALL HIGHER LAYERS
layers.description: Deterministic rules, schema contracts, known-bad data patterns. A regex match on a known-corrupt data signature is not overridden by the LLM's narrative assessment.
components: Schema contracts: dbt tests — a known-null field in a not-null column is rejected
Artifact envelope validation: missing provenance field fails the hand-off regardless of content quality
Design Invariant checks: a proposal touching a locked invariant is auto-rejected regardless of Statistician confidence score
Known-bad data patterns: coordinated abuse signatures, SRM detection formula, PSI threshold crossings

layers.name: Statistical Layer
layers.description: Bayesian belief networks for joint priors. Shannon entropy on data distributions. Graph centrality (PageRank-style) on entity networks. Significance testing, confidence intervals, effect sizes.
components: Bayesian belief networks for data quality priors
Shannon entropy on data distributions
Graph centrality on entity networks
Significance testing: p-values, confidence intervals, effect sizes
Power analysis: minimum detectable effect and sample size bounds

layers.name: Physics-Based Layer
layers.description: Power-law distribution fitting (Kolmogorov-Smirnov tested). Percolation theory for cluster growth and phase transitions. Entropy production rate as a data-quality and platform-health scalar.
components: Power-law distribution fitting: KS-test on event count distributions
Percolation theory: cluster connectivity threshold monitoring
Entropy production rate: data health scalar, increasing entropy signals structural breakdown
Conservation law validation: input/output event count reconciliation

layers.name: State-Superposition Layer
layers.description: Monte Carlo Tree Search over analysis decision trees. Sequential Probability Ratio Testing per branch. Anticipatory analysis: pre-stages hypotheses for most-likely paths before evidence fully arrives. Compresses time-to-insight.
components: Monte Carlo Tree Search over analysis decision trees
Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT) per hypothesis branch
Anticipatory pre-staging of hypotheses for most-likely paths
Branch pruning based on L1 veto states and L2 significance thresholds

layers.name: LLM Orchestrator
layers.description: Synthesis across all lower layers. Proposes actions. Cannot override L1 vetoes. Produces the final analytical narrative.
components: Cross-layer synthesis: integrates L1-L4 signals into a coherent analytical narrative
Action proposals: routes to appropriate agents based on synthesized state
Uncertainty quantification: declares confidence score with methodology stated
layers.constraint: CANNOT override L1 vetoes. A narrative that contradicts a deterministic L1 ruling is auto-flagged as a Storyteller L1 violation.
